label: Gara Toht Lake (fishing)
note: Day or night: Charc Eel. Night only: Norg, with Norg Bait at a hotspot. Mawfish also bite here by day. Cut fish at Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus.

label: Ocean, Er-Phryah's Vigil coast (fishing)
note: Day: Tralok. Day or night: Goopolla, Sharrac (Twilight Bait) and Murkray (Murkray Bait, hotspots only). Night only: Glappid, with Glappid Bait. Cut fish at Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus.

label: Pond west of Twin Horns (fishing)
note: Day: Khut-Khut. Day or night: Mortus Lungfish, more often after dark. Night only: Cuthol, with Cuthol Bait at a pond hotspot. Cut fish at Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus.

label: Ocean, southeast coast by Hillside Ruin (fishing)
note: Day: Tralok. Day or night: Goopolla, Sharrac (Twilight Bait) and Murkray (Murkray Bait, hotspots only). Night only: Glappid, with Glappid Bait. Cut fish at Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus.

label: Mining, Er-Phryah's Vigil bay
note: Approximate, from the wiki hotspot list. Bay west of the Cetus gates by the Grineer camp, marked by Sentient bones in the shallows; it and the nearby cave usually hold 15+ veins in a small area. A Grineer machine periodically electrifies the bones.

label: Mining, Twin Horns caves
note: Approximate, from the wiki hotspot list. Large cave system near the Cetus gates with many veins, quick to run back and reload. Akkalak turrets at the far end.

label: Mining, Mount Nang cave
note: Approximate, read from the map image. Red veins here are a known Auron spot, and rarer gems turn up more often this far from Cetus.
